newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash..

text.p: NOTICE OF BOND SALE $30,000,000 City of Seattle Washington Municipal Light and Power Revenue Bonds, 1996 SEALED BIDS for purchase of the above-described bonds (the Bonds'') will be received by the City of Seattle, Washington (the''City''), at the offices of the Director of Finance, 102 Municipal Building, 600 Fourth Avenue, Seattle, Washington, until 8:30 a.m., Pacific Daylight Time, on October 22, 1996 (or other date and time as may be communicated 24 hours in advance). The bids will be acted on by the City Council at a special meeting on October 22, 1996. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996 and will fully registered, in book-entry form, initially registered in the name of Cede &Co., as nominee for The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York. The Bonds will mature on October 1 in the years 2002 through 2021. Individual purchases of the Bonds will be made in the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds shall be purchased at no less than 98.5 percent of the aggregate principal amount. Interest rates bid shall be in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of one percent, or both, and no rate of interest for any maturity shall be less than the rate of interest for a prior maturity. The approving legal opinion of Foster, Pepper &Shefelman, Seattle, Washington, will be furnished, without cost, to the purchaser of the Bonds. A no-litigation certificate will be included in the closing papers. Further information on the Bonds, and copies of the complete Official Notice of Sale, Official Bid Form and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained, upon request, from the City's financial advisor, Jim Hattori, Seattle-Northwest Securities Corporation (206) 628-5491.
